In this notebook, I will create plots for main figure 2

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

celltypes <- c("ColEpi", "Stroma", "Myeloid", "Plasma", "BCell", "TNKILC")
celltype.figure.order <- c("Colonic Epithelium", "Stroma", "Myeloid", "Plasma Cells", "B Cells", "T Cells, NK Cells, and ILCs")

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
colIBD <- "#EB6D33"

diagSub.comp <- list(c("FGID", "cCD"), c("iCD", "cCD"), c("cCD", "UC"), c("FGID", "UC"))
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

diagGroup.comp <- list(c("FGID", "IBD"))
diagGroupColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "Ileal"=coliCD, "IBD"=colIBD)

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
```

```{r}
obs <- readRDS("out/annotations/scvi/251017__predictCOL_CB_allcells_obs.rds")
obs
```

```{r}
metadata <- readRDS("data/metadata/241120__predictCOL_metadata_COL_GEX.rds")
metadata
```

# Milo

```{r}
da_results.fgidibd.df <- readRDS("out/milo/combined/251017__predictCOL__CB_T0_FGIDCCDUC_ds_milo_k200_10x_fgidibd.rds")
da_results.fgidibd.df
```

```{r}
da_results.fgidccd.df <- readRDS("out/milo/combined/251017__predictCOL__CB_T0_FGIDCCDUC_ds_milo_k200_10x_fgidccd.rds")
da_results.fgidccd.df
```

```{r}
da_results.fgiduc.df <- readRDS("out/milo/combined/251017__predictCOL__CB_T0_FGIDCCDUC_ds_milo_k200_10x_fgiduc.rds")
da_results.fgiduc.df
```

```{r}
da_results.ccduc.df <- readRDS("out/milo/combined/251017__predictCOL__CB_T0_FGIDCCDUC_ds_milo_k200_10x_ccduc.rds")
da_results.ccduc.df
```

```{r}
plotRange <- range(da_results.fgidibd.df$logFC, 
                   da_results.fgidccd.df$logFC, 
                   da_results.fgiduc.df$logFC,
                   da_results.ccduc.df$logFC, 
                   na.rm = T)
plotMax <- abs(plotRange) %>% max %>% ceiling
plotMin <- -plotMax
c(plotMin, plotMax)
```

```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=26}
da_results.fgidibd.df %>% 
  filter(cellstate_fraction >= 0.7) %>% 
  add_count(cellstate) %>% 
  filter(n >= 0) %>% 
  droplevels %>% 
  arrange(cellstate) %>% 
  mutate(contrast = "←IBD     FGID→") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = cellstate, y = logFC)) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(size = 1, aes(color = ifelse(SpatialFDR < 0.1, logFC, NA))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.25, lwd = 2) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Log Fold Change") + 
  guides(color = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(plotMin,plotMax), breaks = seq(ceiling(plotMin/2)*2, floor(plotMax/2)*2, 2)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = colFGID, mid = "gray90", high = colIBD, na.value = "gray75") +
  facet_grid(contrast~celltype,  scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", expand = F) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 22) +
    theme(
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.1,0.3,0.1,0.1), "cm"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, angle = 90),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 3), 
    panel.spacing = unit(.5, "cm"),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
    )
```

```{r}
da_results.fgidccd.colors.df <- da_results.fgidccd.df %>%
  filter(cellstate_fraction >= 0.7) %>% 
  add_count(cellstate) %>% 
  filter(n >= 0) %>% 
  arrange(cellstate, logFC) %>% 
  mutate(logFC.cut = cut(logFC, 200), .after = logFC) %>% 
  mutate(contrast = "←cCD     FGID→") %>% relocate(contrast) %>% 
  droplevels

cuts.ccduc <- da_results.fgidccd.colors.df %>% pull(logFC) %>% cut(200) %>% levels
colors.cduc <- c(colorRampPalette(c(colFGID,"gray90"))(100), colorRampPalette(c("gray90",colcCD))(100))
names(colors.cduc) <- cuts.ccduc

da_results.fgidccd.colors.df <- da_results.fgidccd.colors.df %>% 
  mutate(logFC.color = ifelse(SpatialFDR < 0.1, 
                              colors.cduc[logFC.cut],
                              "gray75"
                              ), .after = logFC.cut)
da_results.fgidccd.colors.df
```

```{r}
da_results.ccduc.colors.df <- da_results.ccduc.df %>%
  filter(cellstate_fraction >= 0.7) %>% 
  add_count(cellstate) %>% 
  filter(n >= 0) %>% 
  arrange(cellstate, logFC) %>% 
  mutate(logFC.cut = cut(logFC, 200), .after = logFC) %>% 
  mutate(contrast = "←UC     cCD→") %>% relocate(contrast) %>%

cuts.ccduc <- da_results.ccduc.colors.df %>% pull(logFC) %>% cut(200) %>% levels

                              ), .after = logFC.cut)
da_results.ccduc.colors.df
```

```{r}
da_results.fgidccduc.colors.df <- rbind(
```

# IHC

```{r}
p28 <- readRDS("out/ihc/panimmune/panel28_long.rds")
p28
```

```{r}
p28.df.wide <- p28 %>% filter(!is.na(diagSub)) %>% 
  mutate(diagGroup = case_when(
    diagSub == "FGID" ~ "FGID",
    diagSub == "iCD" ~ "Ileal",
    diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC") ~ "IBD"),
    .after = diagSub
  ) %>% 
  mutate(diagGroup = fct_relevel(diagGroup, c("FGID", "Ileal", "IBD"))) %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = paste(participant_id, colon_site_ihc, area, sep = "_")) %>% 
  relocate(sample_id) %>% 
  mutate(diagSub = fct_relevel(diagSub, c("FGID", "iCD", "cCD", "UC"))) %>% 
  filter(participant_id %in% metadata$participant_id) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(area)) %>% 
  mutate(across(`CD20+`:`CD3+CD8-FOXP3-`, ~as.double(.)))

p28.df.wide

p28.df.long <- p28.df.wide %>% 
  pivot_longer(`CD20+`:`CD3+CD8-FOXP3-`, names_to = "marker", values_to = "density") 

p28.df.long
```

```{r}
p20 <- readRDS("out/ihc/panimmune/panel20_long.rds")
p20
```

```{r}
p20.df.wide <- p20 %>% filter(!is.na(diagSub)) %>% 
  mutate(diagGroup = case_when(
    diagSub == "FGID" ~ "FGID",
    diagSub == "iCD" ~ "Ileal",
    diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC") ~ "IBD"),
    .after = diagSub
  ) %>% 
  mutate(diagGroup = fct_relevel(diagGroup, c("FGID", "Ileal", "IBD"))) %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = paste(participant_id, colon_site_ihc, area, sep = "_")) %>% 
  relocate(sample_id) %>% 
  filter(participant_id %in% metadata$participant_id) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(area)) %>% 
  filter(str_ends(colon_site_ihc, "-2", negate = T))

p20.df.wide

p20.df.long <- p20.df.wide %>% 
  pivot_longer(`BCMA+`:`NCR1+`, names_to = "marker", values_to = "density") 

p20.df.long
```


```{r}
p28p20.long <- rbind(p20.df.long, p28.df.long %>% mutate(diagnosis_p20 = NA, .after = diagnosis_p28))
p28p20.long
```

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=2.5}
p28p20.long %>% 
  filter(diagSub != "iCD") %>%
  filter(area == "WS") %>% 
  filter(marker %in% c("CD11c+", "MPO+", "CD3+", "CD3+CD8-FOXP3+", "CD20+", "BCMA+")) %>% 
  mutate(marker = fct_relevel(marker, c("CD11c+", "MPO+", "CD3+", "CD3+CD8-FOXP3+", "CD20+", "BCMA+"))) %>% 
  group_by(diagGroup, marker) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(density, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(density, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = diagGroup, y = density)) + 
  geom_dotplot(binaxis = "y", stackdir = "center", stackratio = 0.75, dotsize=1.75, aes(fill = diagGroup)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width=0.4, linewidth=0.6) +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "crossbar", width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.6, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagGroupColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagGroupColVec) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = diagGroup.comp, label = "p.format", vjust = 1.25, size = 5, tip.length = 0.05) +
  facet_wrap(~marker, scales = "free", nrow = 1) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    y = "Cell Count / mm2",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```
